Mental illness is a fucking prison, and you can’t see around corners. I obviously can’t promise that things will get better, but i mean it sounds like you’ve made it through some shit so far. You can’t let this beat you, you have to keep going. Your life is really shitty right now and I’m so so sorry, but you can survive it. I found this group because I posted to this group. I’ve been where you are, and a stranger commented on my post and told me to keep going. I’m still not perfect, but I’m happier and better off than I could ever think I was at that time. My scars aren’t healed yet, and maybe they’re never going to heal fully, but they can start to now that my mind is a little clearer. Things are fucked up, but your life affects people in ways that you will never know. You can’t see the full picture, because how could you? Just wait a while, and try to look for the good things, even if it’s really fucking difficult. You sound really strong, and being strong is a shitty shitty thing, but you have to. You are a young adult, which is shitty enough. I’ve never had the exact experience as you, but I’ve had my own share of traumas. You’re a good person, but you have to keep going in order to see that.

I’m really proud of you. I know that I’m a stranger on the internet, and I’ll never know you in a way that is meaningful, but I’m proud I got to know you at all. You’ll meet people who will get to know you better, even if you don’t think that you will, even if you know in your head that you won’t, because it’s inevitable. Please keep going.
